title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Master Policy Conditions on Programs Held per Tier
content:
**Condition.** A lender or servicer may hold several master programs of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, but only one program per tier: a program is enrolled only when the lender has no other program of the same tier in status enrolled, active or suspended.

All certificates a lender places on loans of one occupancy class and coverage method sit under that tier's program, and each program has its own master policy number, its own account and its own monthly statement. No overall cap on the number of programs per lender is set beyond the one-per-tier condition.

## Condition – judgement – result

| The lender's existing program of the same tier is… | Can a new program of that tier be enrolled? |
|---|---|
| none on record | Yes |
| enrolled | No |
| active | No |
| suspended | No |
| terminated (and no other of the same tier enrolled, active or suspended) | Yes |

The check rests on Tidemark's program records for that lender and that tier, not on the lender's statement. A program of a different tier never blocks enrolment.

## Points of judgement

- *A lender holds an active Residential Gap program and asks to enrol a Commercial Building program.* The tiers differ, so the Residential Gap program does not stand in the way.
- *A lender's only Manufactured Home program is terminated.* A terminated program is not enrolled, active or suspended, so a new Manufactured Home program may be enrolled.
